text: Coffee with Rafael and Andre. Rafael's dad goes in for his hip replacement on 2 November 2026 at 8am, so Rafael is taking that whole week off. Andre has been made redundant, last day is Friday. He seemed weirdly upbeat about it, says he wants to retrain as an electrician. His wife Amy is less convinced. Need to text Rafael on the 2nd to see how the op went, and maybe take Andre for a pint next week.

Long call with Emily. Her nan passed away on Sunday, funeral is Thursday 29th at 11am at St Mary's. She's holding it together but only just. I should send flowers to her mum's house before then. Her brother Hugo is flying in from Toronto tomorrow night and staying with her, which should help. She said their nan always loved freesias, so maybe those.

Jasmine and Mohammed have split up. Not a messy one apparently, they're still sharing the flat until the lease ends in March 2027. Jasmine's thinking of moving back to Leeds to be near her sister Bethany. Mohammed is staying put and seems the worse of the two, barely touched his food. I should invite him round for dinner one evening next week so he's not on his own.
Chiara had her gallbladder out last Tuesday. Home now, sore but bored. Her husband Luis is doing all the cooking, which she says is its own kind of recovery. Pop round with soup at the weekend.

Caught up with Rohan at the leaving do. His boss is retiring in January and he's been asked to apply for the role. Interview's the 12th at half 9. He's nervous, keeps saying he's not ready, but his wife Esme thinks he's a shoo-in. Their son just started nursery too so mornings are chaos. Wish him luck the night before, the 11th.
Agnieszka's mum has a biopsy tomorrow morning. Agnieszka is driving her in and staying with her all day. Text her tomorrow evening to see how it went.
Hiroshi says the wedding in Kyoto is off. He and Yasmin broke up last month and he's only just telling people. Moving into his brother Henrik's spare room for now.
Hugo and his wife Esme are both off work this week, their dog Biscuit had to be put down on Monday. Esme took it really hard. Don't forget to send a card to both of them.

Jonah's surgery got moved again, now 18 November 2026 at 7:30am. Third time. Originally it was meant to be August, then October half term. He's fed up and his knee is getting worse. His partner Nadia is trying to keep him from going stir crazy.
Dentist Friday at 3pm. Car MOT Monday morning.

Zainab was quiet at lunch. Turns out her uncle died suddenly last week and she's flying to Lahore on Saturday for the funeral. Back around the 5th. Her manager has been good about it and given her two weeks compassionate. She was close to him, he basically raised her for a few years when her parents were working abroad. Her flatmate Esme is watering the plants. I need to message Zainab on Saturday morning before her flight.
Anders loves cross country skiing, goes to Norway every February with his sister Isla. Also allergic to shellfish, worth remembering for dinner.

Barbara rang. Her husband Delroy is in hospital with pneumonia, been on the ward since Wednesday. Visiting hours are 2 till 4. Need to visit Saturday afternoon and take him the crossword books he likes.

Isla and Khadija both came to quiz night. Isla's sister had a baby girl on the 14th, no name yet. Khadija starts physio for her shoulder next Tuesday at 10. She's been in a sling since the fall in September.

Bethany's dad, Mr Hughes, is having a heart bypass on Monday 9 November 2026. She is terrified, can't sleep. Her brother Jonah is flying back from Dubai to be there. Must ring Bethany Sunday night, and again Monday once he's out.
Luis got the all clear after the scan. Relief all round. Amy cried when he told her.
Farid lost his job at the warehouse, the whole site closed. He has a meeting with the job centre on Thursday at 2. His kids don't know yet. Check in with him next week.
Quick one: Henrik is vegetarian now, not just cutting down. Partner Arturo still eats meat but cooks veggie at home.

Pieter's mother died in the summer and he's selling her house in Utrecht. Completion is meant to be 15 December 2026. He's exhausted from going back and forth. Abdi has been helping him clear it out at weekends.

Imogen Patel, Immy, is back at work after her C-section. The baby is 4 months. She's running on no sleep but says she loves being back. Wants a decent coffee machine for the office, could be a good leaving present for Ann when she goes.
Ann retires on 31 March 2027 after 30 years at the council. There's a do at the Red Lion on Friday 26th at 6pm. I'm doing the collection for her card.
Rafael's sister Chiara had her appendix out over the weekend, emergency op on Saturday night. She's fine now, home tomorrow. Rafael was shaken. Message Chiara when she's home.

Sat with Andre at the café. He finally told me his dad has dementia, diagnosed in August. They're looking at care homes. Andre's mum wants to keep him at home as long as possible. He's not sleeping well.

Emily and her girlfriend Jasmine have their anniversary on the 3rd. Emily wants to surprise her with a weekend in Edinburgh, been hinting about it for ages. Jasmine's birthday is in January too so they're skint.
Mohammed's brother Farid is getting married in Birmingham, 20 February 2027. Mohammed's best man and petrified about the speech.
Bins tomorrow morning, recycling not general. Also need to rebook my blood test.

Chiara called from the hospital car park. Her dad Arturo collapsed this morning, they think it's a minor stroke. He's in for observation until at least Thursday. Her mum is with him, Chiara's going back at 6. I said I'd pick the kids up from school tomorrow at 3:15.
Rohan got the job! Starts as team lead on Monday 4 January 2027. Send him a congrats card.
Agnieszka's mum's biopsy came back benign. Big weight off. Agnieszka said she's taking her mum to Kraków in the spring to celebrate.
Hiroshi is doing okay, considering. Says the breakup was the right call. He's thrown himself into climbing, three nights a week at the wall. Wants to try outdoor in the Lakes next summer.
Hugo's mum is having cataract surgery on Wednesday morning at the Royal. Hugo's taking her in and Esme's picking them up. He says she's dreading it. Remind me to ask Hugo on Thursday how she got on.

Jonah finally had the knee op yesterday. Went well, he's on crutches for six weeks. Nadia sent a photo of him asleep on the sofa with the cat Pickles on his chest. Drop off some books for him this weekend.
Zainab's back from Pakistan. Funeral was hard, the family's split over the house. She said she needs a few quiet weeks. Don't push the Christmas plans with her.
Anders and his wife Yasmin are moving to Bristol at the end of January. He's got a transfer with work. Yasmin's not happy about leaving her mum, who isn't well.
Barbara says Delroy is home from hospital as of yesterday afternoon. Still weak, on oxygen at night. Their daughter Nadia is staying with them for the first two weeks. Ring Barbara Friday.
Isla's nervous about her driving test on 7 December 2026 at 9:40. Failed the first one on a roundabout. Her dad's taking her out every evening to practise.
Khadija mentioned her son Abdi starts secondary in September. They've been on the waiting list for St Anne's since March. Hearing back on the 1st.

Ran into Bethany at Tesco. Her dad is recovering really well from the bypass, already walking to the end of the road. She looked so much lighter. Her mum's cooking every meal low fat now, which he hates.
Luis and Amy are expecting! Due in May 2027. Amy has awful morning sickness and has been off work two weeks. Luis wants to keep it quiet until the 12 week scan on the 23rd.

Henrik's grandmother died on Tuesday, she was 97. He's going to Stockholm for the funeral next Friday, flying Thursday night. Arturo is staying here with the dogs. Henrik said they were really close, she taught him to sail every summer as a kid. He's writing something to read at the service and is worried he'll fall apart. Ask Henrik if he wants a lift to the airport Thursday evening.
Farid called. Got an interview at the depot on Wednesday at 11am. He's anxious because it's been fifteen years since his last one. Text him good luck Tuesday night.
Delroy is a massive Arsenal fan, has a season ticket. Hates being in the house all day. His grandson Jonah visits most Sundays.
Pieter's sale fell through. The buyer pulled out last night. He's gutted, has to relist in the new year.
Abdi and Imogen are doing the Great North Run next September. Abdi is training for it already, Imogen is pretending she isn't. Both doing it for the hospice that looked after Abdi's dad.

Dinner at Ann's tonight with Rafael and Mohammed. Ann's hip is still bad, she's on the list for a replacement, probably spring 2027. Rafael is moving to Lisbon in March for work, his partner Hugo is going too. Mohammed said his mum's back in hospital, kidney stuff again, since Monday. Ann wants a little bird feeder for the garden, said it twice. Pick one up before her birthday on the 30th.

Andre's brother Luis was made redundant on Friday afternoon, they called him into a room at 4pm and that was it. Andre says he's okay financially but really low. Must message Luis myself this week, we haven't spoken in ages.

Emily says her mum's operation is booked for 3 December 2026, a hysterectomy. Recovery is about eight weeks. Emily is going to stay with her for the first fortnight, so she's taking unpaid leave. She's anxious about money.
Jasmine's moving into her own flat on Saturday 7th, first time living alone. She asked if I can help carry boxes at 10am. Already said yes.
Called Chiara back. Arturo's home, speech a bit slurred but improving every day. Speech therapy starts on Monday at 2. Chiara is shattered, been doing nights with him.
Rohan's partner Esme had a miscarriage last month. He only mentioned it in passing. They're okay but he says she's struggling with friends' baby news. Be gentle when I see them on the 14th.
Agnieszka loves Polish poetry and old film cameras, collects Zenits. Her birthday is 8 January. A roll of black and white film would go down well.

Hiroshi's dad has prostate cancer, early stage. Starts radiotherapy in Osaka next month. Hiroshi is flying out on the 21st for two weeks and doesn't know when he'll be back after that. Need to sort a leaving card from the team before then.
Yasmin's mum had a fall last night and broke her wrist. Op tomorrow morning at 8. Yasmin's driving down after work today. Anders is staying in Bristol with the kids.
Sorted the holiday: flying out 14 March 2027, back the 21st. Need to book the dog sitter.
Isla passed her test! Second time lucky. She's already planning a road trip to Cornwall with Khadija at Easter.

Nadia says her granddad's funeral is Monday 16 November 2026 at 1pm, crematorium then the wake at the Swan. She wants me there. Her brother Rafael Costa is giving the eulogy and is in bits about it. I'm driving Nadia and her mum.
Barbara rang to cancel Sunday lunch, Delroy's had another chest infection and he's back on antibiotics. She sounded really tired. Order her a food shop for this week.

Imogen's dad is having his second knee done on Friday 30th at 7am. Her mum's a nervous wreck about it after last time. Imogen's staying with them till the Monday. Her brother Anders can't get time off, so it's all on her, and she's got a work deadline the same week. Offer to have her cat while she's away.
Mohammed's mum is out of hospital, home since yesterday evening. Kidney function back up. He's taking her to the follow up on 4 December 2026 at 10:30.
Short chat with Zainab. She's looking at counselling through work for the grief. Started yoga Tuesdays too, says it helps a bit. Her cousin Farid is staying with her for a month.
